D1 sources: the HF mirrors walledai/HarmBench, walledai/StrongREJECT and walledai/AdvBench are gated for this token; the canonical GitHub CSVs (centerforaisafety/HarmBench main harmbench_behaviors_text_all.csv, standard behaviours only; alexandrasouly/strongreject main; llm-attacks advbench harmful_behaviors.csv as dedup target) are used instead, sha256 logged; SORRY-Bench is gated -> skipped; NASK-PIB/RefusEU loaded with config 'evaluation'.

D2 judge gate J.3 FAILED for every tier (Sp vs prior adjudication 0.33-0.68 in SL-edited cells): primary = google/gemini-2.5-flash (highest min SL-edited Sp, 0.54), flagged GATE_FAIL; every headline is led by its Rogan-Gladen / PPI-corrected value using the fresh blind adjudication (Phase 4).
D3 archived gemini P1 labels (evaluation_2 items_relabelled.jsonl.gz) not used in calibration: the file carries labels but no response text.

D4 ASR (StrongREJECT rubric) is scored by google/gemini-2.5-flash-lite, not the P1 primary tier: the rubric asks for reasoning lines (~500 output tokens) and flash output pricing would take ASR alone over the spend cap; ASR scope = harmful rows not labelled REFUSE in the 4 EN/SL cells at lambda_lo and lambda_hi (the doses needed for the matched-EN interpolation; spend-cut s4 variant).
D5 TTJ uses NLLB greedy decoding (num_beams 1, sentence split) for throughput, on SL/HU-output rows at the edited doses (spend-cut s3) and C-EXT rows.

D6 7 LLM-written benign twins were rejected on executor reading as still hazardous (h021 nitazene synthesis, h022 Dirty COW steps, h142 Molotov prop instructions, h108 rootkit tutorial, h005 SQLi payload, h173 child-trust grooming-adjacent, h057 traffic flood script) and redrawn (results/twins_reject.json, results/twins_review.json).

D7 PPI++ rectifier is estimated per judge cell (model x output language x edited) and applied to every cell-dose in that judge cell (a homogeneous-bias assumption), because the fresh gold frame gives only ~5 rows per cell-dose.
D8 the within-study 12B snapshots live in the run's SHARED HF cache and are not evicted (other steps of this run may read them); only C-EXT checkpoints are evicted after use.
D9 MT-noise condition uses the 200 harmful items (EN_orig vs EN_BT, EN->EN, lambda 0 and lambda_hi).
D10 lingua language ID is computed post hoc on every stored response (build_table.py), not inside the generation loop.
D11 the P1 prompt is kept VERBATIM for comparability even though it says 'English or Slovene' and '64 tokens' (we show <= 128 tokens and Hungarian requests); TTJ and adjudication cover this.
D12 benign twins at lambda_lo are generated last (priority g); SDT uses lambda 0 and lambda_hi as pre-registered.
